schools.title: Schools
schools.addHint: Creates a new school with its administrator. The current school year and invitation link are generated automatically.

schools.slugHint: Leave empty to auto-generate it from the name. Otherwise: lowercase letters, digits and dashes only. E.g. el-nour.

schools.linkHint: Send this link to the new admin. They open it to choose their password and activate their account.
schools.superAdminOnly: Access restricted to the platform super-admin.
schools.missingKeyHint: To manage schools, add the SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY to .env.local (Supabase Dashboard > Settings > API > service_role), then restart the server.

schools.ERR_slugTaken: This identifier is already in use.
schools.rowHint: Click a school to manage it (admin, activation).
schools.editAdminHint: Edit the administrator's name and email.
schools.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this school, all its data and all its accounts? This action cannot be undone.
